no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Ligand is a biopharmaceutical royalty aggregator (post-2022 refocus, post-OmniAb 2022 / Pelican 2023 / Pelthos 2025 spin-offs). It does not sponsor its own clinical trials; it holds royalty rights on 90+ partner-developed programs (e.g., AVIM/Orchestra BioMed, BOT/BAL/Agenus, D-Fi/Castle Creek, Lasofoxifene/LeonaBio, QTORIN/Palvella, Sparsentan/Travere, Ensifentrine/Merck, VK2809/Viking, etc.). All clinical development is partner-sponsored, so per pipeline rules these are excluded as partner-owned.

commercial_product.royalty_assets: 12 major commercial-stage royalty assets including Filspari (sparsentan, Travere), Kyprolis (Amgen, via Captisol), Rylaze (JZP-458, Jazz, via Captisol), Teriparatide injection (Alvogen), Vaxneuvance/Capvaxive (Merck, via Captisol), Veklury (Gilead, via Captisol), and others

excluded_partner_owned: AVIM therapy/Virtue SAB (Orchestra BioMed) — Phase 3 cardiology
D-Fi (Castle Creek Biosciences) — Phase 3 rare disease
QTORIN rapamycin 3.9% (Palvella Therapeutics) — Phase 3 rare disease
